workflow.place.gates.title: Gates
workflow.place.gates.body: The declaration at the line's tip, shown once. Each choice below is your acceptance for its own purpose, pinned to the blob you read, kept on its own record and withdrawn on its own.
workflow.place.gates.nothing: No gates here ask for your acceptance: the work that lands names no verification, and the line declares no integration.
workflow.place.gates.pick: Choose what to accept, then confirm.
workflow.place.gates.cleared: {{label}}: the declaration changed since you chose it, so the choice was cleared.
workflow.place.gates.landed.label: Accept for landed verification
workflow.place.gates.landed.purpose: The checks of the work that lands run these gates unasked.
workflow.place.gates.landed.waits: Blob {{blob}} at {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}}. Accepted, its checks run them; until then nothing verifies the work that lands.
workflow.place.gates.landed.changed: The declaration changed since you accepted it: verification stops until you accept it again.
workflow.place.gates.landed.acceptedNone: Accepted as none: {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}} declares no gates.
workflow.place.gates.landed.unread: Where the landed route's gates stand could not be read here.
workflow.place.gates.integration.label: Accept for integration
workflow.place.gates.integration.purpose: The line's integration uses the declaration's `integration` object: the files it writes, the rules it runs, the scratch it clears.
workflow.place.gates.integration.waits: Blob {{blob}} at {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}}. Accepted, integration uses it; until then none of it is used.
workflow.place.gates.integration.changed: The declaration changed since you accepted it: integration goes on under blob {{blob}} until you accept this one.
workflow.place.gates.integration.accepte: Accepted as none: {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}} declares no integration.
workflow.place.gates.integration.unread: Where the integration declaration stands could not be read here.
workflow.place.gates.confirm.label: Accept the chosen gates
workflow.place.gates.confirm.says: Accepts the declaration shown, by its blob, for each purpose chosen. A tip that moved since you read it is refused, and nothing is written for it.
workflow.place.gates.summary.none: Nothing here asks for your acceptance
workflow.place.discard.label: Replace the steps you are editing
workflow.place.discard.says: Change… replaces the editor. The changes you have made to these steps are not saved and cannot be got back.
workflow.place.change.title: Change what its work follows
workflow.place.change.body: Select a workflow to see it drawn, then use it for {{route}}. A preset is saved as a copy first.
workflow.place.change.pick: Select one to see it drawn here.
workflow.place.change.noGraph: This preset has no steps to draw.
workflow.place.change.steps: This version is made of steps, which the chart draws once it is chosen.
workflow.place.change.chosen: Chosen. New work here follows it; running work keeps the version it started with.
workflow.place.change.copy.name: Name of the copy
workflow.place.change.own: {{place}} follows a workflow of its own for {{route}}; the workspace's applies where it follows none.
workflow.place.change.currentLive: Follows its old landing rule, read as the rule stands. Converting saves it as a workflow and points the place at it.
workflow.place.change.savedNone: No workflow is saved here yet.
workflow.place.ask.fill: I have {{place}}'s workflow open in the editor, and I want to change it:
workflow.place.steps.title: Its steps
workflow.place.steps.body: Edit a version's steps in the editor, judged as you go. Saved, a version is chosen here and running work keeps the one it started under.
workflow.place.repositories.summary: {{count}} repository, {{own}} with rules of its own
workflow.place.repositories.summary_othe: {{count}} repositories, {{own}} with rules of their own
workflow.place.chart.older: This driver does not draw a route's graph yet, so the chart waits for it.
workflow.place.chart.landedNone: Landed work follows no verification here, so there is no chart to draw.
